definitions.explanation: The social and economic class between the wealthy and the poor. In Japanese discourse, often refers to the broad middle segment of society that characterized postwar Japan.

examples.japanese: {中間層|ちゅうかんそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}っている→減る：01985_heru⟧。
{中間層|ちゅうかんそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{所得|しょとく}→所得：09850_shotoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伸|の}び{悩|なや}んでいる→伸び悩む：11457_nobinayamu⟧。

⟦{新興国|しんこうこく}→新興国：21746_shinkoukoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{中間層|ちゅうかんそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{拡大|かくだい}→拡大：02553_kakudai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{経済成長|けいざいせいちょう}→経済成長：20453_keizaiseichou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支|ささ}えている→支える：01946_sasaeru⟧。
examples.english: In emerging countries, the expansion of the middle class is supporting economic growth.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{中間|ちゅうかん}→中間：05458_chuukan⟧ (middle, intermediate) + ⟦{層|そう}→層：12441_sou⟧ (stratum, layer). In Japan, the concept of a broad middle class was central to postwar national identity — the phrase {一億総中流|いちおくそうちゅうりゅう} ("100 million all middle class") captured this self-image.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中間層|ちゅうかんそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{拡大|かくだい}→拡大：02553_kakudai⟧ — expansion of the middle class
- {中間層|ちゅうかんそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{縮小|しゅくしょう}→縮小：02568_shukushou⟧ — shrinking of the middle class
- {中間層|ちゅうかんそう}{向|む}け — aimed at the middle class

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{中流|ちゅうりゅう}→中流：11368_chuuryuu⟧ — middle class (less formal)
- ⟦{中産階級|ちゅうさんかいきゅう}→中産階級：29180_chuusankaikyuu⟧ — middle class (more formal/academic)
- ⟦{富裕層|ふゆうそう}→富裕層：12390_fuyuusou⟧ — wealthy class
- {低所得層|ていしょとくそう} — low-income group
